hints.title: Digit Counting
hints.text: Count the appearances of each decimal digit 0 through 9 in the number.

hints.title: Minimum Nonzero Frequency
hints.text: Find the smallest occurrence count greater than zero.

hints.title: Tie Breaking by Magnitude
hints.text: Scan digits from 0 to 9 in ascending order and return the first one having the minimal frequency.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def getLeastFrequentDigit(self, n: int) -> int:
        s = str(n)
        freq = Counter(s)
        
        min_f = min(freq.values())
        # Pick smallest digit among those with min_f
        cands = [int(d) for d, f in freq.items() if f == min_f]
        return min(cands)
```

variables: D: Number of digits in n
